notes.content: The Graphic Design program at Sacramento State is one of the most highly sought after programs in Northern California. Due to a large number of applications, the program is officially impacted . To declare the Graphic Design major, students must complete the lower-division major prerequisites and apply for admission to the program after transfer. The application for admission to the major includes a portfolio. For additional information, please see a Graphic Design advisor. Before submitting an application and portfolio for admission to the major, students must have completed or be enrolled in the following courses: GPHD 25, GPHD 30, and PHOT 12. Additionally, students must have completed or be enrolled in at least 2 of the following: DSGN 4, DSGN 20, GPHD 5, or GPHD 20. All courses must be completed with a "C" grade or higher. For additional information, please visit: Department of Design .
